summary: Completed comprehensive testing of WebSocket Real-Time Notifications feature for EduNet. All 12 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: WebSocket connects (green dot indicator), notifications update in real-time, badge count updates instantly, tabs display correctly, mark-all-read works. Minor finding: Toast notifications from sonner are imported and called but not visually confirmed in automated tests (may be timing/automation issue).

issues: Toast notifications may not appear reliably - sonner v2.0.3 Toaster component exists but toast visibility could not be confirmed in automated testing. Manual testing recommended.
